summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path, following the spec's seven-step procedure, and added test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with a module-scoped Turtle fixture, one parametrized test over valid and invalid shapes (including a graph-unchanged check), and a separate test for None and plain-string inputs. Running pytest on the new tests and test/test_path.py gives 41 passed. Not verified: mypy, ruff, and black were not run because the shared venv only has pytest, so the type-ignore placement (including the one on the pytest.raises line) and formatting are checked by reading only. Nothing was committed, and no packages were installed or venv files changed.
